speaker_title: Address by Ms. Mette Frederiksen, Prime Minister of Denmark

paragraphs.text: Mr. President, dear delegates,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President, dear delegates,

paragraphs.text: No one can be in doubt. We live in a connected world.
paragraphs.raw_text: No one can be in doubt. We live in a connected world.

paragraphs.text: We face global challenges. They can only be solved if we work together.
paragraphs.raw_text: We face global challenges. They can only be solved if we work together.

paragraphs.text: COVID-19. Human rights violations. Climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text: COVID-19. Human rights violations. Climate change.

paragraphs.text: Poverty on the rise. Conflicts.
paragraphs.raw_text: Poverty on the rise. Conflicts.

paragraphs.text: As a founding Member of the UN, Denmark is a strong voice for common solutions.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a founding Member of the UN, Denmark is a strong voice for common 
solutions.

paragraphs.text: And today, we need global cooperation more than ever.
paragraphs.raw_text: And today, we need global cooperation more than ever.

paragraphs.text: Throughout history, international solidarity has moved us forward.
paragraphs.raw_text: Throughout history, international solidarity has moved us forward.

paragraphs.text: It has the power to do so again.
paragraphs.raw_text: It has the power to do so again.

paragraphs.text: Out of the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text: Out of the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: We must ensure global access to vaccines.
paragraphs.raw_text: We must ensure global access to vaccines.

paragraphs.text: None of us can leave COVID behind until all of us can.
paragraphs.raw_text: None of us can leave COVID behind until all of us can.

paragraphs.text: Denmark is committed to vaccine solidarity and COVAX.
paragraphs.raw_text: Denmark is committed to vaccine solidarity and COVAX.

paragraphs.text: In the spring, we announced the donation of 3 million vaccine doses.
paragraphs.raw_text: In the spring, we announced the donation of 3 million vaccine doses.

paragraphs.text: This week, we announce a redoubling of our efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text: This week, we announce a redoubling of our efforts.

paragraphs.text: We now aim to donate more than 6 million doses.
paragraphs.raw_text: We now aim to donate more than 6 million doses.

paragraphs.text: That is more than one donated vaccine for each Dane.
paragraphs.raw_text: That is more than one donated vaccine for each Dane.

paragraphs.text: It comes in addition to our commitment to COVAX with more than $15 million.
paragraphs.raw_text: It comes in addition to our commitment to COVAX with more than $15 million.

paragraphs.text: If we are to battle this pandemic. We have to strengthen our ability to prevent and respond to future pandemics.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If we are to battle this pandemic. We have to strengthen our ability to prevent 
and respond to future pandemics.

paragraphs.text: International solidarity also has the power to prevent a climate disaster.
paragraphs.raw_text: International solidarity also has the power to prevent a climate disaster.

paragraphs.text: The latest IPCC report makes it clear that we are standing at a global crossroad.
paragraphs.raw_text: The latest IPCC report makes it clear that we are standing at a global crossroad.

paragraphs.text: We must continue our path towards a green future. And we must do it faster.
paragraphs.raw_text: We must continue our path towards a green future. And we must do it faster.

paragraphs.text: We need to keep the Paris Agreement goal alive. Limiting the global temperature rise to 1.5°C.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to keep the Paris Agreement goal alive. Limiting the global 
temperature rise to 1.5°C.

paragraphs.text: Climate change hits the world’s poorest and weakest communities hardest.
paragraphs.raw_text: Climate change hits the world’s poorest and weakest communities hardest.

paragraphs.text: Denmark will respond to the call of the Secretary-General. And massively scale up Danish grant-based climate finance to at least $500 million a year by 2023.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Denmark will respond to the call of the Secretary-General. And massively 
scale up Danish grant-based climate finance to at least $500 million a year by 2023.

paragraphs.text: And we are dedicating 60 per cent to adaptation in poor and vulnerable countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And we are dedicating 60 per cent to adaptation in poor and vulnerable 
countries.

paragraphs.text: In addition, we are strengthening our efforts to mobilize public and private finance from other sources.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addition, we are strengthening our efforts to mobilize public and private 
finance from other sources.

paragraphs.text: In total, Denmark aims to contribute at least 1 per cent of the collective target of $100 billion.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In total, Denmark aims to contribute at least 1 per cent of the collective target 
of $100 billion.

paragraphs.text: At the same time, we are fully focused on reducing our own emissions.
paragraphs.raw_text: At the same time, we are fully focused on reducing our own emissions.

paragraphs.text: Denmark will be climate-neutral no later than 2050.
paragraphs.raw_text: Denmark will be climate-neutral no later than 2050.

paragraphs.text: And by 2030, we have committed to cut our greenhouse gas emissions by 70 per cent. We have decided to end production of oil and gas. And build the world’s first energy islands. In time, they will create clean energy for millions of European households.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And by 2030, we have committed to cut our greenhouse gas emissions by 70 
per cent. We have decided to end production of oil and gas. And build the world’s 
first energy islands. In time, they will create clean energy for millions of European 
households.

paragraphs.text: We call on you all to follow. And to do so urgently.
paragraphs.raw_text: We call on you all to follow. And to do so urgently.

paragraphs.text: Every one of us need to act and adapt individually. But we also have to act for the common good.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Every one of us need to act and adapt individually. But we also have to act for 
the common good.

paragraphs.text: That is the case in Afghanistan as well.
paragraphs.raw_text: That is the case in Afghanistan as well.

paragraphs.text: The current situation is disturbing. For the long-suffering people of Afghanistan. For the women and children. And for the international community.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The current situation is disturbing. For the long-suffering people of Afghanistan. 
For the women and children. And for the international community.

paragraphs.text: We need a strong and coordinated response. The contribution at the international donor conference last week was an important step.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need a strong and coordinated response. The contribution at the international 
donor conference last week was an important step.

paragraphs.text: I would like to express my appreciation for the commitment of our international humanitarian partners. They are providing life-saving assistance. In Afghanistan. And in the many other places.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to express my appreciation for the commitment of our international 
humanitarian partners. They are providing life-saving assistance. In Afghanistan. 
And in the many other places.

paragraphs.text: Peace missions are keeping peace, preventing conflicts and paving the way for progress every day around the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Peace missions are keeping peace, preventing conflicts and paving the way for 
progress every day around the world.

paragraphs.text: No people in conflict zones should be forgotten.
paragraphs.raw_text: No people in conflict zones should be forgotten.

paragraphs.text: We must include those that have been excluded. And empower those that have been powerless.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must include those that have been excluded. And empower those that have 
been powerless.

paragraphs.text: Women and young people have a vital role to play. In peacebuilding and conflict prevention.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Women and young people have a vital role to play. In peacebuilding and 
conflict prevention.

paragraphs.text: Denmark remains committed to the agenda for Women, Peace and Security.
paragraphs.raw_text: Denmark remains committed to the agenda for Women, Peace and Security.

paragraphs.text: International solidarity has the power to give us hope.
paragraphs.raw_text: International solidarity has the power to give us hope.

paragraphs.text: Hope for a better future in the places we call home. Hope for protection when we need it.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Hope for a better future in the places we call home. Hope for protection when 
we need it.

paragraphs.text: But for many around the world, this hope comes at a high price.
paragraphs.raw_text: But for many around the world, this hope comes at a high price.

paragraphs.text: We are leaving the destiny of too many people to human smugglers.
paragraphs.raw_text: We are leaving the destiny of too many people to human smugglers.

paragraphs.text: The current asylum and migration system does not address the challenges we face today.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The current asylum and migration system does not address the challenges we 
face today.

paragraphs.text: We need to do better. To save lives. To prevent rape and abuse.
paragraphs.raw_text: We need to do better. To save lives. To prevent rape and abuse.

paragraphs.text: It calls for new common solutions.
paragraphs.raw_text: It calls for new common solutions.

paragraphs.text: My government is devoted to addressing the root causes.
paragraphs.raw_text: My government is devoted to addressing the root causes.

paragraphs.text: We have dedicated a large amount of funding to regions of conflict. To help create conditions for a better future where people live. To help more people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have dedicated a large amount of funding to regions of conflict. To help 
create conditions for a better future where people live. To help more people.

paragraphs.text: We need to work together to ensure safe and orderly migration. And to protect those in need.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to work together to ensure safe and orderly migration. And to protect 
those in need.

paragraphs.text: Denmark is committed to a strong and efficient UN. That protects the rulebased international order, promotes a more progressive world, and fights injustice.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Denmark is committed to a strong and efficient UN. That protects the rule-
based international order, promotes a more progressive world, and fights injustice.

paragraphs.text: Last year, we asked the Secretary-General to report back to us — the Member States — with recommendations to advance Our Common Agenda.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Last year, we asked the Secretary-General to report back to us — the Member 
States — with recommendations to advance Our Common Agenda.

paragraphs.text: He has done so. Now we have to act on these recommendations. All of us.
paragraphs.raw_text: He has done so. Now we have to act on these recommendations. All of us.

paragraphs.text: The Social Contract between governments and people should be renewed. In our own societies. And at the global level.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Social Contract between governments and people should be renewed. In 
our own societies. And at the global level.

paragraphs.text: As host of the Social Summit in 1995, Denmark feels a special responsibility. So that we may gather again in 2025 and continue the work towards the SDGs. Thirty years on from Copenhagen and on the road to 2030.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As host of the Social Summit in 1995, Denmark feels a special responsibility. 
So that we may gather again in 2025 and continue the work towards the SDGs. Thirty 
years on from Copenhagen and on the road to 2030.

paragraphs.text: Thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you.
